name: audio_ren_thread
doc: The host's render thread of one renderer (src/audio/ren.ts; nxnative render_main): a guest thread whose body is host code. Idle: no thread. Ready: the loop looks at its output. Waiting: all four blocks are in flight; it waits for the output to hand one back (the release event, at most 10 ms). Rendering: the SDK's ExecuteAudioRendererRendering runs on the thread (it generates commands, processes them and signals the game's renderer event; the host takes the DeviceSink's samples inside it). PlayQueued: a catch-up frame an update rendered is played in place of a render. Stop: the renderer is no longer Running; the output is closed and the thread ends.
